events.title: Demo Update: Focus Chime Volume and Story Unlock Hints
events.summary: Hi everyone, Thank you for trying the demo during Next Fest, and for all your feedback! Here's what's new: New and ImprovedA new Focus Chime slider in Settings → Audio lets you set the volume of the pomodoro chimes (start, break, back to focus, and end of a full cycle). When a chime plays, music and ambience now dip automatically, so you won't miss your break reminder. Locked chapters in Story now show "Focus to reach Level X to unlock", and the list now ends with a "More chapters" entry marked

events.title: Small Demo Update: Monitor Selection and Camera Drag
events.summary: Hi everyone, This is a small update. Here's what's new: New and Improved A new Monitor option in Settings → Quality → Display lets you choose which screen the game runs on. You can now drag to rotate the camera. The How to Play guide in Help now notes: Your points, level and focus history from the demo will carry over to the full game, which will add many more items and outfits to unlock. events.title: Demo Update: Particle FX Are Here
events.summary: Hi everyone, Thank you for playing the demo! This update opens up particle FX, so you can shape the effects in Yiling's room yourself. Here's what's new: Particle FXA new Room tab in Dress Up, with two FX items: the Hologram Box on the desk, and the Holo Window. Tune the particles in the item details: particle count, color, position and more. Hit Generate Random for a new effect every time, or write your own Formula under Advanced to move the particles exactly the way you want. Save the effects

events.title: Demo Update: Costumes Are Here, with the New Summer Gym Uniform
events.summary: Hi everyone, Thanks for all your support on the demo! Today's update opens up costumes, and Yiling has her first new outfit. Here's what's new: Costumes Are HereThe Costume tab in Dress Up is now open, so you can change Yiling's top and socks. New outfit: the Summer Gym Uniform, plus three kinds of socks: Ankle Socks, Mid-Calf Socks and Thigh-High Socks. New items are unlocked with Points, which Yiling earns while she focuses. Other UpdatesRedesigned the "Log progress" pop-up for plans. Bug Fixe

events.title: Demo Update: Redesigned Plans Panel
events.summary: Hi everyone, Thanks for all your support on the demo! Today's update redesigns the Plans panel. Here's what's new: Redesigned Plans Panel A brand-new layout: your plans are clearer to read, and every feature is more intuitive to use. New Notes: add optional details to any plan. Notes sync through Steam Cloud. Search by plan title, tag or note. Your existing plans, focus records and game progress are all kept. events.title: Demo Update: How to Play Guide, Interface Settings & Redesigned Audio Bar
events.summary: Hi everyone, Thanks for all your support and feedback on the demo! Today's update adds a How to Play guide and Interface settings, redesigns the audio bar, and tweaks a number of smaller details. Here's what's new: New How to Play: the first time you start the game, a short guide explains how the story advances and how outfits are unlocked. You can view it again anytime in Settings → Help. Interface settings page: use "Background dimming" to adjust how much the scene darkens behind an open panel

events.title: Demo Update: Graphics Settings Overhaul, Better Indoor Shadows & Floating Pomodoro Timer
events.summary: Hi everyone, Thanks for all your support and feedback on the demo! Today's update overhauls the graphics settings, improves indoor shadows, adds a floating mini Pomodoro timer, and brings a round of tweaks to several panels. Here's what's new: Graphics & Performance Graphics settings overhaul: added three presets (Low, Standard and Ultra), with per-option adjustments available under "Quality details". events.title: Ripple Lane 101 : Moments With You — Demo Day-One Update
events.summary: Thank you for your interest! Alongside the demo launch, we're rolling out a sizeable update: Settings New "Render scale" option, with a default picked automatically for your screen resolution — noticeably higher frame rates on high-resolution displays Higher maximum volume: full volume is now louder than before, while the default volume stays the same New "Auto camera" toggle All-new Inspiration panel A redesigned interface for recording your inspirations; you can now create and delete your own
